instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Okay, remember that strange D shape, whatever it was we built? So we're building that again in the top left corner. So here you want to put a red block. On top of that you want to take a green block with the short side facing you and place it so that the center of the green block is on top of the red block. Take a blue block with the long side facing you and put it on top of the green block so that the centers of the two blocks are aligned in sort of a cross manner. Same thing that we did before, but just in the top left corner here. So red, then you have a green and then you have the blue. Oop!
